Find the particular solution to the differential equation dydx=e4x−y that satisfies y(0)=5.

a
y=ln⁡(e4x+4e5−14)
b
y=ln⁡(e4x+5)
c
y=ln⁡(e4x4+C)
d
y=ln⁡(e4x−14)
e
y=ln⁡(e4x4+e5+14)
